Title: They shrink - but here's the fix!
Review: I love these pants - the color is great, the style is comfortable and easy but can be dressed up. like other reviewers, i washed these according to the care instructions and they shrunk horribly. however - after some googling, i was able to find a fix. soak the pants for 5-10 minutes in warm water mixed with 3-4 tsp hair conditioner. gently wring them out and start to (gently) stretch the fabric as much as possible. hang on a drying rack and continue to gently stretch the fabric as the pants dry

Title: It's exactly what I wanted!
Review: I looked at almost 100 jackets in stores and websites before I decided on the Columbia Men’s Watertight II Jacket, and I was not disappointed. Here are the features I wanted and how well they satisfied my needs:WHAT I WANTEDI live near the ocean where mist, spray, and rain are playing all the time. Also, I’m planning a trip near the Rhine River where I expect it to be raining almost constantly. I wanted a light, combination windbreaker and rain jacket that I could pack in little space and rely on to keep me dry.WEIGHTMy Columbia Men’s Watertight II jacket weighs 15 ounces on my digital scale. That’s fine.WATERPROOFINGMy Columbia jacket has been out in some heavy rains, without any leaks. The sealed seams kept out the weather, the hood and cuffs didn’t leak, and I stayed dry.THE HOODThe nylon hood is large, and better worn over a cap. It adjusts with an elastic cord held tight in rubber washers. It keeps the wind away and blocks the rain well. If you pull the cord tight, it closes up the area under your chin.THE ZIPPERThe fine zipper keeps the jacket closed up and over your chin. Small patches of Velcro on the storm flap protect from sideways-blowing wind and rain. An elastic cord in a tensioner keeps the bottom loose or tight around your body.As in all other light jackets I have owned, you have to guide the zipper over folds in the fabric. If you grab it at the bottom and give it a John Wayne heave, it will get caught.THE SLEEVESThe sleeves are plenty long and close with Velcro bands, so wind and rain don’t sneak in. The sleeves are lined right down to the cuffs, with netting and a double layer of nylon. Whatever your arm length, the Velcro bands will keep the cuffs where you want them.THE POCKETSThere are two large mesh-lined side pockets with zippers under flaps. One of them has a double zipper so you can stuff the jacket inside the mesh pocket, leaving a zipper pull outside.BREATHABILITYOn windy days, the jacket keeps me warm, especially with a sweater underneath. I haven’t found myself perspiring as in nonbreathable fabric jackets. The coated nylon fabric is backed by an open mesh. When you move your arms and torso, air trapped inside the jacket vents, improving ventilation. If you want more ventilation, unzip the mesh pockets, and open the bottom.WINDPROOFINGWith the hood, sleeves, and bottom shut, the wind cannot leak inside. Several times on windy days, I thought it was calm and opened the zipper only to find the wind whipping through.RECOMMENDATIONSThis Columbia Men’s Watertight II jacket meets my requirements, and I look forward to wearing it around town and carrying it on my rainy trip. If what I’ve written appeals to you, you’ll like it too.

I will say that overall, it fits probably just SLIGHTLY larger than I would normally expect for a Medium (as someone who is typically a sz 6-8, athletic build) however since these are comfortable clothes, it isn't enough that I would size down at all. They're pretty perfect in my book!

In the moments needed to get the item and return to cover, the jacket was soaking wet. It took a long while that day to dry. Now that it's past amazon's returnable date, probably I will give the jacket to a Christian ministry that supplies good used clothing to the homeless. Title: Flattering style but inconsistent fit
Review: I ordered 4 of these in various colors and different sizes at various times. So my review is mixed overall. For reference, I’m 5’5” and 105lbs.The page recommended I get a small but the small was too large overall. The shoulder area was too wide, even though I have relatively wide shoulders. Also the fit around the shoulders were odd. One side poofed out and forward in a very not-flattering way so that one of my bra straps showed no matter how I shifted it around. Back this one went.The neckline plunge down, and a bit unevenly. It was most definitely too low cut for me. The torso/waist area fit fine for me.I exchanged it for an XS. The olive green one mostly fit pretty well but one of the shoulders had the same uneven fit problem as the S, but less pronounced. The torso fit slightly tighter but still fit. It was cropped a bit shorter. It’s at a bit of an awkward in-between cropped and hip-length for me. It hit just at my navel. So probably better with high waisted pants or low rise pants depending on what you’re going for. I wound up returning this one as well because of the same shoulder gap issue.The black XS fit the best. I didn’t have the shoulder gap problem, it was still slightly shorter in the torso (but not actually cropped)  than I prefer but workable. I do love the style with the square neckline and the lantern sleeves. I kept this one.I also got the white one which was noticeably smaller at the same XS size. It was too small for my preference. It was more fitted which I could wear but I just don’t like it that form fitting. Regardless it was inconsistent with the other two XSs. It was more cropped, clingy and smaller overall.The material has some give but not a lot. But it’s also quite substantial, so the material feels like it has a slight bit of compression ability. Depending again on how you like your clothes to fit. I would’ve preferred the length and torso fit of the S but the more narrow shoulder and shorter neckline of the XS. I think the material is perfect for autumn.In conclusion, I think the fit posed a challenge to whoever Amazon uses to manufacture these tops and resulted in plenty of inconsistencies. Had I not order a bunch of these in various colors, I wouldn’t have known.My suggestion is to order a few of these and try them out to see which ones fit the best if any.I also included a photo of the olive green one because I think the photos they used are a bit off in color. The photos make it look more like a yellowish split pea soup color, but it’s a true olive green in person.Hope this helps!

After I took it off I hung it on a hook on my wall.  From Sunday evening till Tuesday morning, all I could smell was what reminded me of a greek yogurt throw up bomb.  I couldn't figure out where the smell was coming from.  I washed all of my bedding, checked my carpet to make sure one of my dogs didn't leave me a special surprise.  I put my nose to literally everything in my room just trying to figure out WTF smelled so sour.It wasn't until I picked the dress up again to make my decision that I realized the smell of death was coming from the garment in my hands.Signed, sealed, delivered back to you Amazon.  Whatever died in this dress is going to need an exorcism.

Title: Size down if you’re in between. But the quality is unimpressive.
Review: The fabric’s texture gives away that it’s a cheap blazer. I have my fair share of cheap-but-good Amazon finds, but this one…not so much. The button looks big, too bulbous, and tacky. It’s hard to tell in my pic, but in person it’s pretty bad. If the jacket wasn’t too big and I decided to keep it, I’d literally replace the button.The fabric weave isn’t smooth enough to fool anyone — it’s obviously medium-low quality. Not thin, but its medium-weight feel doesn’t do enough to hide that it’s poor quality. No way could I wear this to a job interview in person. It might work if it was via Zoom.Size L — I often wear sizes medium and large. I got a Large. I’m 145 lbs, 5’4” 38D with broad shoulders, narrow waist, broad hips. The large was BIIIIIG on me. Too big to wear it as a fashionably oversized blazer. It didn’t taper at the waist enough either, so even if it fit me overall, I suspect it would’ve been boxy, and again, not fashionably so on me. Doesn’t have that 90s blazer look. If you’re an apple shape, it might work for you.Too long overall. The arms are eeextra long, and I have somewhat long arms. I suspect the medium would’ve been too long there as well. That said, if you want to wear it with the sleeves cuffed, you can show off the inner lining—that material is quite nice, actually.All-in-all, you’re better off finding a budget blazer at H&M, Ross, etc. I’m returning this and not bothering with trying the medium. It looks better in the pictures than real life.

From my shopping experiences, I don't touch any Amazon Brands/Goodthreads/etc because it's mostly low-quality crap (sorry but that's the truth).This sweater, however, breaks that mold completely.I never expected something of this quality for under $30 shipped to my door. Every bit of the stiching, from the arms to collar to waist are impeccable and double/triple sewn for durability not just a once over like an old navy or gap piece.  Secondly, the material is high-quality and thick in a good way (not heavy enough to bake you, but it stops that cold winter wind solidly it doesn't cut through).Back to the stiching: The bear design? It's not some cheap iron-on, it's sewn through the entire sweater so I can already tell I'm never going to see any pilling/peeling/fraying but let's say 3 years down the line it does fray a little, it's the perfect style for that anyway for me because the sweater reminds of an irish cabeknit with the warm ring-collar and all.I couldn't be more pleased really, and I think I'm going to start giving Goodthreads another chance because they are definitely stepping their game up.

I wear a belt so I dont have to keep hiking jeans up, but find I did pull these up several times a day.The legs are mostly straight through the thigh, a tiny bit narrower at the knee, but not much taper after that. I have solid thighs, and large calves (boot buying is never fun) and own slim ankles... these jeans do not cling, but wearing a neoprene knee brace underneath leaves no spare room. I might have considered a 6, but was hoping for space for the brace.The fabric feels like traditional modern denim, not 1920s canvas-denim, and not leggings style stretch-denim...., just modern denim with a tiny bit of stretch... which I hoped meant 2-3 days wear, without looking /feeling worn out.  But they just seem to relax over the first day, and bummer, feel like "5th day wear" on the second day... so to me, that's 1 day wear jeans.Color was good.

Title: Sequoia color shown is NOT accurate
Review: I just received my order for 541s in the color "Sequoia," and they are MUCH darker than shown on Amazon's website. That isn't a problem if you like really dark blue jeans, but I was expecting something much lighter. I checked the PC9 code (found on the laundry instructions label), and the Levi's website says that what I got is "Dark Wash." So, it could be that Amazon simply shipped the wrong thing; maybe the photo *is* correct? I won't know until I get the replacements I requested.Update, a week later: Amazon sent my replacements, and they're exactly the same as the first shipment. I did *not* receive "Sequoia." The PC9 code on these is 18181-0027. I've tried to reach Amazon service to explain their problem to them, but there's no easy way these days to reach a human who might understand. So, again, if you like "Dark Wash," go ahead and order. There's nothing inherently wrong with the jeans, they're just not the "Sequoia" color shown on the web page.

Title: Love love love!!
Review: I used to only wear Levi’s when I was in my 20’s. Then I had a baby and I’m not sure if they made the high rise jeans yet but I stopped buying them. Now I’m 44 and I’m a Levi girl again! High rise all the way only because I get a muffin waist with anything else. These eliminated that for me completely. No more tight belts or having to constantly pull the waist of my jeans up. These are red tab Levi’s so the jean material is sturdier than the lesser priced one, which I tried before. Usually my jeans eventually rip in the upper inner thigh/crotch area. But not these!! I have several pairs and even my oldest pair is still going strong. They have a stretch to them that is a miracle for me. I work 12 hour shifts and always wear Levi’s. They are extremly comfortable.I live in Arizona so during the summer I wear the ones that have at least one rip in the legs which is like air conditioning for my legs. It is nice to grab a pair of jeans from my closet and always be putting on my favorite go-to jeans. I wash them inside out (unless I got something on them) and dry on medium and remove them from dryer before they are super hot.I wonder if I can buy stock in these because I believe these are the best jeans out there. I haven’t tried expensive jeans but expensive jeans start off with that negative of costing so much so I just don’t go there, it just doesn’t seem worth it to me. Even the highest priced Levi’s are a great buy. They have been doing jeans for a long time and they know how to make us look good.Keep in mind there are different #s for different fits so what ever you prefer for your body size and shape they will have something for you to love too!

Title: Size down if you’re in between. But the quality is unimpressive.
Review: The fabric’s texture gives away that it’s a cheap blazer. I have my fair share of cheap-but-good Amazon finds, but this one…not so much. The button looks big, too bulbous, and tacky. It’s hard to tell in my pic, but in person it’s pretty bad. If the jacket wasn’t too big and I decided to keep it, I’d literally replace the button.The fabric weave isn’t smooth enough to fool anyone — it’s obviously medium-low quality. Not thin, but its medium-weight feel doesn’t do enough to hide that it’s poor quality. No way could I wear this to a job interview in person. It might work if it was via Zoom.Size L — I often wear sizes medium and large. I got a Large. I’m 145 lbs, 5’4” 38D with broad shoulders, narrow waist, broad hips. The large was BIIIIIG on me. Too big to wear it as a fashionably oversized blazer. It didn’t taper at the waist enough either, so even if it fit me overall, I suspect it would’ve been boxy, and again, not fashionably so on me. Doesn’t have that 90s blazer look. If you’re an apple shape, it might work for you.Too long overall. The arms are eeextra long, and I have somewhat long arms. I suspect the medium would’ve been too long there as well. That said, if you want to wear it with the sleeves cuffed, you can show off the inner lining—that material is quite nice, actually.All-in-all, you’re better off finding a budget blazer at H&M, Ross, etc. I’m returning this and not bothering with trying the medium. It looks better in the pictures than real life.

Title: A good blazer for everyday office wear
Review: This is a good blazer for everyday office wear. First, about the size: I purchased size Large, in Orange. I went by the size chart and Amazon's recommendation, but I think I could have gone with the Medium (I'm 5'4" and 139 lbs). The large is just a tad too roomy.  This may be one of those times when large is too large and medium is just a tiny but too small, but if I order another blazer, I will try the medium next time.Now, the color: I love orange, but I love a soft orange. Not coral, soft orange. There is a difference! I bought another blazer from another company in orange, and it was traffic cone orange -- too bright for me. When I came to this listing, I read a lot of people complaining that their orange blazer was more coral, but I decided to give it a try. Well, mine isn't coral. It is still orange, just not traffic cone orange, or spiced orange, or coral orange. It is not quite as soft as I anticipated, but it is still a softer orange than my original one, so I am keeping it.And finally, about the style: I really like the lapels and the button closure. I also like the pockets, but I tuck my flaps in. The way the pockets are sewn, the seam is finished so the pocket flaps look good tucked in, and it does not show through when you do. Leaving the flaps loose just emphasizes the hip area for me, and looks cleaner to me tucked in. I can also put my hand in the pocket easier if the flaps are tucked.In all, 4/5 stars!

Review: I'm 6ft 3 225 lbs and these fit well bit waist and length. Nice jeans and great price.

Title: Comfy casual dress
Review: I love how comfortable this dress is, it does run a little large so i would order a size down. i'm 5'3" and around 125lbs and had to exchange the xsp for an xxsp.

Title: Great cardigan
Review: Great cardigan. love the tie on the back of the collar. excited i was able to get the blue on sale. definitely runs big, but the small fits me well!

Title: Boho perfect
Review: If you love the boho style then this too is for you. it is very pretty and pairs well with skinny jeans, leggings, sandals, boots, and booties.  i bought it in the orange color which is more of a burnt orange which is perfect for fall. it does run big which is the style so you could size down and still have room to hide flaws. for reference i'm 5'3 and bought the pm but needed the ps. i have recievied tons of compliments and i'm thinking of getting the silver one too!

Title: Good deal
Review: Looks nice and is inexpensive.

Title: Nice and durable but huge
Review: It was way too big. I am a shorter guy at 5’6 but other shirts fit way better. I ended up cutting the sleeves off and turned it into that.

Title: Not petite inseam...
Review: I was excited to see these jeans since they came in petite sizes and had a short inseam... unfortunately after ordering/returning several pairs, i found out that these are actually not petite jeans. please beware that if you are ordering these for the shorter inseam, they are actually 28 in... not 24 in as in the description. other than the inseam issues, they fit like typical paige denim.

Title: Lovely little dress
Review: Never would have thought i would love it so much based on the picture online but saw it in person and it's so cute!!  colors are very rich in person - even the soft pink (not a big pink gal) works so well with the other colors.  great quality with full lining.  i lucked out and picked it up for a steal on clearance with another 40% off!  just love it!!
